Remark
[Frankel intersection argument]

Source: petersen:page-0286 ↗ rem:pet-ch6-frankel-theorem 1. ch6:6.7.18Let $M$ be $n$-dimensional with $\sec >0$ and $A,B$ closed totally geodesic submanifolds. Show directly (via a shortest connecting segment and the second variation formula, without invoking section 5) that $A\cap B\ne \emptyset $ if $\dim A+\dim B\ge n$.
